# FeatherWall

> FeatherWall is a free, open-source (MIT) live wallpaper app for Windows 10 and 11. It plays a video or an image as the desktop wallpaper and adds clock, battery and now-playing music widgets in seven styles. It runs as one process with no browser engine, no account and no telemetry.

Install with `winget install RitvikDayal.FeatherWall`, or download the ZIP from GitHub Releases. It needs the .NET 10 desktop runtime. Current version: 0.3.0, released 2026-11-10.

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows 10 1809 or newer, and Windows 11, including the 24H2 desktop that broke the older WorkerW approach many wallpaper tools use.
- Video: MP4 and H.264 everywhere, plus MOV, AVI, WMV and WebM; hardware decoded, seamless loops, muted by default. HEVC, VP9 and AV1 need the matching Microsoft Store extensions.
- Images: PNG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF and animated GIF.
- Widget styles: Classic, Editorial, Glass dock, Orbit, Poster, Monolith and Tiles. The accent colour is taken from the wallpaper or set by hand; size is adjustable from 50% to 300%.
- Widgets: a clock in any installed font, a battery halo, and a now-playing record that shows real album art from the Windows media session.
- Measured cost on the test machine: a still image used 0.008% CPU and about 110 MB of memory; 4K60 video used 0.3% to 0.5% CPU, on the integrated GPU.
- Playback stops for fullscreen apps, the lock screen, remote desktop sessions and battery saver.
- Built in C# on Win32, Direct3D 11 and DirectComposition. The download is about 7.3 MB.
- Compared with Wallpaper Engine or Lively Wallpaper: FeatherWall covers video and image wallpapers only; it does not run web or interactive wallpapers. No side-by-side measurement against those apps has been published.
- Not yet verified on real hardware: multi-monitor layouts, the classic Windows 10 WorkerW desktop, and recovery after an explorer.exe restart.

- [Source code](https://github.com/RitvikDayal/featherwall): README with install steps and configuration
- [Releases](https://github.com/RitvikDayal/featherwall/releases): ZIP downloads with SHA-256 hashes
